lines.speaker: LANTERN
lines.style: Measured, commanding over low-frequency radio crackle.
lines.text: Shadow Section, Varrow Harbor is cloaked in sea fog and rain. The Dominion garrison is hunkered down, which gives us our window.

lines.speaker: LANTERN
lines.style: Clear, deliberate emphasis on the primary goal.
lines.text: Your objective is the fire-control radio inside the cliff-top battery. Disable that transmitter before dawn, or our approaching convoy will be torn to splinters in the strait.

lines.speaker: LANTERN
lines.text: If opportunity permits, secure the harbor master's naval codebook from his desk. It will unlock Dominion coastal movements for months.

lines.speaker: LANTERN
lines.text: Otter will ferry you ashore beneath the north quay. Once the battery is silent, rendezvous at the north navigation buoy for extraction.

lines.speaker: LANTERN
lines.style: Firm, protective edge in her voice.
lines.text: Keep your heads down. If the battery raises the alarm, the barracks will pour reinforcements up that cliff road, and I expect all six of you back in one piece.

lines.speaker: LANTERN
lines.text: Bring them silence, Shadow Section. HQ out.

lines.speaker: MOTH
lines.text: Shifting into the fog now.

lines.speaker: MOTH
lines.text: Securing the anchor point.

lines.speaker: MOTH
lines.text: Sentry pacing this way. Stay low.

lines.speaker: MOTH
lines.text: Target sleeping. Path is clear.

lines.speaker: OWL
lines.text: Repositioning to bearing zero-four-zero.

lines.speaker: OWL
lines.text: Tagging target on the overlook now.

lines.speaker: OWL
lines.text: Sentry closing from west, twenty paces.

lines.speaker: OWL
lines.text: Dart struck home. Sentry is down.

lines.speaker: BADGER
lines.text: Moving my boots, nice and quiet.

lines.speaker: BADGER
lines.text: Let Uncle Dez coax this lock open.

lines.speaker: BADGER
lines.text: Heavy steps coming. Duck your heads.

lines.speaker: BADGER
lines.text: Beautiful girl, purring like a kitten now.

lines.speaker: FOX
lines.text: Stepping onto my mark, darling.

lines.speaker: FOX
lines.text: Time for a little harmless misdirection.

lines.speaker: FOX
lines.text: Our audience approaches. Curtain down, everyone.

lines.speaker: FOX
lines.text: And the gentleman takes his final bow.

lines.speaker: HERON
lines.text: Moving up. Keep breathing, friends.

lines.speaker: HERON
lines.text: Administering a gentle dose right now.

lines.speaker: HERON
lines.text: Footsteps approaching. Do not make a sound.

lines.speaker: HERON
lines.text: Patient is resting comfortably. No complications.

lines.speaker: OTTER
lines.text: Swimming with the tide. On my way.

lines.speaker: OTTER
lines.text: Rigging the line fast and true.

lines.speaker: OTTER
lines.text: Greycoats drifting our way, fast current.

lines.speaker: OTTER
lines.text: Clipped his fins. Sentry is out cold.

scenes.title: Night Watch at the Harbor Pier

lines.speaker: GUARD_B
lines.text: My fingers are frozen stiff, and the galley served us turnip paste that tasted like canal mud.

lines.speaker: GUARD_A
lines.text: Pull your greatcoat collar tight and stop whining, lad. The cold keeps you awake, and awake keeps you breathing.

lines.speaker: GUARD_B
lines.text: Did you hear the men from third watch? They swear phantoms are slipping through the fog, snatching sentries off the line.

lines.speaker: GUARD_A
lines.text: Campfire drivel meant to frighten green conscripts. There are no ghosts in Varrow, only salt mist and drafty piers.

lines.speaker: GUARD_B
lines.text: Wait. By the freight crates past the slipway. I heard wood creak.

lines.speaker: GUARD_A
lines.text: It is harbor rats chewing tallow, like every other night. Stay by the lantern. I will check the crates.

lines.speaker: GUARD_B
lines.text: Do you see anything? Do not go too far into the dark.

lines.speaker: GUARD_A
lines.style: Shocked, sudden shout of pure alarm.
lines.text: Brandt is down in the ditch, bound and gagged! Alarm! Intruders on the north quay!

lines.speaker: LANTERN
lines.style: Urgent, hushed tone breaking radio silence.
lines.text: Shadow Section, hold your breath. HQ just intercepted an encrypted dispatch from the Dominion harbor garrison.

lines.speaker: LANTERN
lines.text: They picked up a lone Coalition scout along the bluffs an hour ago. He is being held inside the harbor master's office for interrogation.

lines.speaker: LANTERN
lines.text: The battery remains your priority, but bringing that scout home will save an entire network. I leave the call to you.

lines.speaker: FOX
lines.text: I have played drafty provincial theaters, Dez, but crouching in rotten herring nets pushes my artistic limits.

lines.speaker: BADGER
lines.text: Quit fidgeting, Celeste. A whiff of salted mackerel never killed anyone. Dominion machine gun fire certainly will.

lines.speaker: FOX
lines.text: At least machine fire has dramatic presence. This smell will take root in my wool coat until next winter.

lines.speaker: BADGER
lines.text: Hunker down. Sentry patrol is three paces away. Listen to those heavy hobnails crushing the gravel.

lines.speaker: FOX
lines.text: His posture is appalling. If I were staging this scene, he would be demoted to stagehand before the first act closed.

lines.speaker: BADGER
lines.text: Save the review for the morning papers, actress. Let him pass the net first.

lines.speaker: LANTERN
lines.style: Warm satisfaction beneath a crisp exterior.
lines.text: Convoy Vanguard just cleared the strait without facing a single round from the cliffs. The guns remained blind and deaf.

lines.speaker: LANTERN
lines.text: Our decoders already have the harbor master's codebook in hand. The Dominion still has no idea how their cipher went missing.

lines.speaker: LANTERN
lines.style: Soft, maternal pride veiled in dry military wit.
lines.text: Otter brought you all out clean, without leaving so much as an oil slick behind. Outstanding work, the lot of you.

lines.speaker: LANTERN
lines.text: Get some dry clothes and warm rations. Command is eyeing an alpine rail bridge in the high passes, and we move at dusk.
